Note: Notice that when modal verbs are used, the preposition "to" is not needed.

A gerund is a noun formed with a verb ending in -ing.

For example:
Shopping is fun.
Smoking is a bad habit.

A gerund can be used as the subject of the sentence.

For example:
Living in small villages is what they have always done.
Maintaining their own traditions and values is what keeps them together and makes them unique.

A gerund can also used as a complement of the verb "to be".

For example:
Vanessa is shopping.
I am reading a book.

Gerunds are used as adjectives when they describe something that causes an emotion.

For example:
The movie is exciting.
This is an interesting article.

Gerunds are used after prepositions.

For example:
Richard is good at playing the guitar.

images.text:
Culture is the food we eat, the clothes we wear, and the way we live our lives. A multitude of unique cultures are to be found around the world.
A culture remaining the same for hundreds of years can happen. This is to be seen in the Tibetan culture, whose way of life goes back many years.
Most Tibetans are found living in small villages, but there are other Tibetans who are still nomadic. Playing their own music and doing their own particular types of dance help keep their traditions alive.
As many other cultures continue to be adjusted as the world changes, the Tibetans allow theirs to remain unchanged. In this way, they remain faithful to their values, customs, and traditions.

Being connected to the environment is part of the Zambian tradition. Living in small villages is what they have always done and what continues to be done even now,  when much of the world has been industrialized. Many Zambians still make their living hunting, fishing, and farming. A surprising seventy percent of the Zambian labor force is to be found doing agricultural work while only thirty percent are to be encountered in industry or services.

In some countries, like India, the culture constantly changes.This country with a 5,000 year history, has allowed itself to be transformed over the years. On the one hand, there is the documentation of how different religious movements and political events have shaped India over time to be seen in their art. Both worlds intermingle so the past, present and future are all evident at once.
For most people, their culture is a source of pride. Maintaining their own traditions and values is what keeps them together and makes them unique.
